item.text: {"analysis_packet":{"certificate":"The immutable anchor is an online, standard-library two-segment byte-aware policy with recent/frequent resident stores, ghost histories, adaptive recent_target, promotion on hits, and eviction until used plus incoming size fits capacity. Its contract requires legal integer-key evictions, exact capacity safety, online-only decisions, and no oracle or trace access. The stated candidate hypothesis conflicts with the fixed topology: it presupposes an executable artifact and complete generative-source visibility at the terminal call, while this lineage permits only upstream analysis and cuts anchor, hypothesis, and loop sources before terminal emission.
